title: A Orchard for the Summer
author: Rafael Dravenmoor
blurb: Emrys Reyes, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
